name: Esaka Sougen
source: A gentleman who runs an antique shop business in the city of Kazamatsuri. After meeting [url=/c267]Kotarou[/url] on a certain occasion, he grants him advice that draws from his vast life experience. Although calling himself a "totally humorous, somewhat mischievous businessman", his gags oppositely charm everyone with fear.
